title: Colorability passes to subgraphs
statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be Boolean encodings of graphs on the same finite vertex set, and let $q$ be a natural number. If every edge present in $G$ is present in $H$ and $H$ has a proper coloring with $q$ colors, then $G$ has a proper coloring with $q$ colors.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number v specifying the finite vertex set
Every edge present in G is present in H
H is colorable with q colors
